definition: GPT-5.1 is a family of five large language models within OpenAI's GPT series.
details: Three were released on November 12, 2025; two more were released one week later on November 19.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. That pattern-earned fluency is GPT-5.1.
